Co-founder / Vicky

VICKY.

From coaching others
to winning Mr. Jharkhand.

Vicky grew up with limited means and a strong pull toward martial arts and fitness. He built a career coaching others in local gyms.

During that career, he travelled to Uttarakhand to learn MMA and kickboxing, and participated in a fight. He returned, entered bodybuilding and won Mr. Jharkhand.

Mr. JharkhandBodybuilding / Winner

@vicky.gymbroPlaceholder handle

Co-founder / Upendra

UPENDRA.

14 years in the Indian Navy.
Still finding new ways
to move.

Engineering led Upendra to the Indian Navy. Across 14 years as an officer, he developed his understanding of training, gyms and nutrition.

Alongside lifting, he found calisthenics. He has participated in Mr. Jharkhand and Mr. Kheda Men's Physique, and continues to build his practice.

Handstand. Front lever. Back lever.
Backflips. Elbow levers.
Currently learning: planche.

The conversation / Early

2025.

VickyUpendraGYMBRO

For ten years, they had known each other on and off. Whenever Upendra came home on leave, he trained at the local gym where Vicky coached.

In early 2025, Vicky approached him with a question.

“Do you want to open
a gym in partnership?”

Vicky's question, as recalled by Upendra.

Yes.

Upendra's answer
was immediate.
He called it the calling.

That conversation
became a club.

Two different journeys.
A shared beginning.
Vicky & Upendra.

GYMBRO.
